## Change

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:ui` for user-flow changes
- [ ] English and Korean copy, mobile layout, and keyboard behavior checked for UI changes

Add screenshots for visible changes and name any checks that were not run.

## Review notes

Explain material tradeoffs, data handling changes, or deployment requirements, if any.
